items.w1-mail-mia: Hi! I'm Mia. I work at the town library. We have a lot of comics and magazines. Come and read a story with me!
items.w1-mail-leo: Hello, neighbor! I'm Leo. The plaza is old and dirty. Can you help me fix it? I need some wood and two crops.
items.w1-talk-leo: What do you want to grow on your farm?
items.w1-quest-mia: We will have a reading party soon. Please bring two carrots for the snacks.
items.w1-story-mia: Mia shows you an old book. "This book has no title," she says. "It is a story about a happy farm." "Can you give it a title?"
items.w1-story-mia_say: Let's call it The Happy Farm.
items.w2-mail-leo: Thank you for your help! I was nervous about the plaza, but now I feel calm. You are a lovely neighbor.
items.w2-mail-mia: I'm sorry I was not at the library yesterday. I felt unhappy and wanted to be alone. Today I'm glad again!
items.w2-talk-mia: Do you want to hear a joke?
items.w2-quest-leo: My friends are coming to the plaza. Please bring two potatoes. We will cook together and laugh a lot.
items.w2-story-leo: Leo is shouting at a broken chair. Then he stops and smiles. "Sorry, I was angry," he says. "Shouting does not fix chairs. Friends do."
items.villager_Mia: Hi, I'm Mia. I'm the town librarian. I love quiet rainy days and a good story. I'm a little shy, but I always want to hear about your day.
items.villager_Mia_motto: Every book is a new friend.
items.villager_Leo: Hello! I'm Leo, the town carpenter. I can fix almost anything with my hammer. I get angry fast, but I say sorry fast too!
items.villager_Nora: Good morning! I'm Nora, the baker. I get up very early to make bread. Please come and eat with me!
items.arrive_Nora: Hello, neighbor! I just moved to your town. My son Ben will join me soon. I opened a small bakery by the plaza. Come and try my bread!
items.villager_Ben: Hey! I'm Ben. I'm twelve years old. I love soccer and music. One day I want to play the drums on a big stage!
items.arrive_Ben: Hi! I'm Ben, Nora's son. The plaza looks so cool now! Can we build a stage? I want to play the drums there.
items.villager_Sam: Hello there. I'm Sam. I travel from town to town and sell things from far away. This town is lively now, so I want to stay a while.
items.villager_Sam_motto: A fair price makes everyone happy.
items.arrive_Sam: Hello! This town looks happy. Can I park my cart here? I want to open a market here one day.
items.villager_Lily: Hi! I'm Lily. I sell flowers. I think every town needs more colors!
items.arrive_Lily: Hello! I'm Lily, Mia's old friend. Mia told me about your town. Can I sell flowers here?
items.villager_Tom: Hi there! I'm Tom, the mail carrier. I walk all over town every day. I know everyone's name!
items.arrive_Tom: Good morning! I'm Tom. Your town gets so many letters now, so I moved here to help. I will bring your mail every day!
items.villager_Jack: Hello! I'm Jack. I'm a fisherman. I go out to sea every morning before the sun comes up. The sea is my best friend.
items.villager_Jack_motto: Be patient, and the fish will come.
items.arrive_Jack: Hello! I'm Jack, a fisherman. Sam showed me his old map, so I came to the east beach. My boat needs a safe home. Can we fix the old pier?
items.villager_Rosa: Hello, I'm Rosa. I'm the town doctor. Do you have a fever or a cough? Come and see me. And don't forget to eat your vegetables!
items.villager_Rosa_motto: Eat well, sleep well, and have fun.
items.arrive_Rosa: Hello! I'm Rosa, a doctor. Jack told me your town has no clinic. So I opened one by the harbor. Come and see me if you feel sick.
items.villager_Max: Hey! I'm Max. I'm a lifeguard. I keep everyone safe in the water. I love swimming and running. Do you want to race me?
items.arrive_Max: Hi! I'm Max, a lifeguard. Jack told me about the beach. I want to keep everyone safe in the water. Let's have a beach festival!
items.task_p1-wood: I need four pieces of wood. I will make a long table.
items.task_p1-weeds: There are so many weeds! Can you help me pull them?
items.task_p1-stone: Please bring three stones. I want to fix the old wall.
items.task_p1-carrot: Working is hard. Let's eat some carrots! Can you bring two?
items.task_p1-flowers: The plaza looks sad. Could we put some flowers here?
items.task_p2-stone: Let's make a stone path. We need five stones.
items.task_p2-carry: These stones are heavy! Help me carry them, please.
items.task_p2-rice: I want to make rice cakes for everyone. Please bring three bags of rice.
items.task_p2-potato: Potato bread is my favorite. Can you bring two potatoes?
items.task_p2-lantern: At night the plaza is too dark. Two lanterns will help.
items.task_p3-wood: We need six pieces of wood to build a stage.
items.task_p3-drums: Let's get ready for the show! Help me set up the drums.
items.task_p3-bench: People need a place to sit. Can we get a bench?
items.task_p3-carrot: I'm making carrot cake for the party. I need three carrots.
items.task_p3-flowers: Flowers make everyone smile. Can you bring two more flowers for the stage?
items.task_m1-wood: A market needs stalls. Can you bring five pieces of wood?
items.task_m1-build: I will build the stalls. Can you help me hold the boards?
items.task_m1-stone: The ground is too soft. Please bring four stones for the floor.
items.task_m1-potato: I want to sell potato bread at the market. I need three potatoes.
items.task_m1-lantern: Let's hang a lantern on the gate. Then people can find us at night.
items.task_m2-corn: Can you grow some corn for me? I need three ears of corn for my stall.
items.task_m2-pumpkin: I'm making pumpkin soup! Can you bring two pumpkins?
items.task_m2-flowers: Flowers make the market look nice. Can you help me add two flower beds?
items.task_m2-sign: Let's paint a big sign for the market. Can you help me?
items.task_m2-wood: The tables are too small. I need six more pieces of wood.
items.task_m3-mailbox: People will send letters about the market. We need a mailbox here.
items.task_m3-carry: So many boxes! Help me carry them to the stalls.
items.task_m3-pumpkin: Big pumpkins make people stop and look. Please bring three.
items.task_m3-tree: A tree gives us shade. Can we plant one by the stalls?
items.task_m3-rice: I'll make rice balls for the shoppers. I need four bags of rice.
items.task_h1-wood: The old pier is broken. Can you bring six pieces of wood?
items.task_h1-fix: The waves broke these boards. Let's fix them together!
items.task_h1-stone: Big waves hit the pier every day. Five stones will make it strong.
items.task_h1-nails: My old map was right! We need nails for the pier. Can you give me six coins to buy some?
items.task_h1-potato: Jack gets up very early. I'll make potato soup for him. I need three potatoes.
items.task_h2-stone: A lighthouse needs strong walls. Please bring six stones.
items.task_h2-iron: The big lamp needs an iron frame. Can you find two pieces of iron ore?
items.task_h2-carry: There are so many steps! Help me carry the lamp to the top.
items.task_h2-carrot: Building a lighthouse is hard work. Let's have some carrot soup. Please bring three carrots.
items.task_h2-lantern: I need to take letters to the lighthouse, but the path is too dark at night. Please bring two lanterns.
items.task_h3-clean: Let's clean the beach before the festival. Help me pick up the trash!
items.task_h3-medals: Let's make wooden medals for the swimming race. Please bring two pieces of wood.
items.task_h3-parasol: Too much sun is bad for your skin. Let's put up two beach umbrellas.
items.task_h3-corn: I'll make grilled corn for everyone at the festival. Please bring four ears of corn.
items.task_h3-boat: Kids can ride in a little boat at the festival. Can we get a sailboat?
items.catch_quartz: You found a piece of quartz!
items.line_thanks: Thank you! I love your gift!
items.quest_mia-5: It's raining again. I love this sound. Let's read together by the window. Can you bring two carrots? I'll make carrot cake for us.
items.quest_mia-5_say: I love reading on rainy days.
items.quest_mia-10: I wrote a poem, but I'm too shy to read it. Will you stand next to me? Please bring some flowers. They make me feel brave.
items.quest_leo-5: I want to make a new bench for the plaza. Hold this board for me, please. Careful! Don't hit your finger!
items.quest_leo-10: Oh no, my old hammer is broken. With some iron ore, I can make a new one. You are a good friend. Thank you!
items.quest_nora-5: Good morning! The oven is hot. Can you help me make rice bread? Mix it slowly. Yes, like that!
items.quest_nora-10: Let's have a picnic by the sea! I will make salmon sandwiches. Ben, don't eat them all!
items.quest_ben-5: Do you want to play soccer with me? Kick the ball to me! Wow, you are fast!
items.quest_ben-10: Tonight is my first drum show! I'm a little nervous. Can you hang a lantern by the stage?
items.quest_sam-5: Look at this old map. It shows a secret beach in the east. Bring me a piece of quartz, and I'll show you the way.
items.quest_sam-10: Let's walk up the hill before dark. I have traveled far, but this view is my favorite. This amethyst will help me remember today.
items.quest_lily-5: Good morning! My flowers are thirsty. Can you help me water them? Look, the sunflowers are smiling at us!
items.quest_lily-10: I want to make flower crowns for everyone. Shiny quartz will make them sparkle. Here, this one is for you!
items.quest_tom-5: I have so many letters today! Can you walk with me and help? This one is for Mia, and this one is for Leo.
items.quest_tom-5_say: I'll help you deliver the letters!
items.quest_tom-10: Today is my birthday, but I have to work. Oh! Is this a surprise party for me? Sardines are my favorite! Thank you, everyone!
items.quest_jack-5: Do you want to go fishing on my boat? Hold the rope tight. Here comes a wave! Look! You caught a big fish!
items.quest_jack-10: There was a big storm last night. My boat is broken, but I'm not giving up. With some wood, we can fix it together.
items.quest_jack-10_say: Your boat looks as good as new!
items.quest_rosa-5: Time for a health check! Open your mouth and say "Ah." Good! You are very healthy. Can you bring two pumpkins? I'll make pumpkin soup for my sick patients.
items.quest_rosa-10: Achoo! I have a bad cold and a sore throat. Doctors get sick too. Could you make me some hot potato soup?
items.quest_rosa-10_say: Take some medicine and get some rest.
items.quest_max-5: Let's race to the lighthouse! Ready, set, go! Wow, you're fast! You almost beat me!
items.quest_max-5_say: I love running on the beach!
items.quest_max-10: Today I'll teach you to swim. Kick your legs. Don't be scared. I'm right here! You did it! Let's eat some grilled corn to celebrate!
items.quest_mia-15: Some kids are coming to the library for story time. I'm nervous, but I want to try. Can we put a bench by the window for them?
items.quest_mia-20: I have a secret. I wrote a book about our town! You are in it, too. You are my brave friend. Let's celebrate! Can you bring two shrimp?
items.quest_mia-20_say: I can't wait to read it!
items.quest_leo-15: I shouted at Mia yesterday. I feel bad. I was tired, and I got angry too fast. Let's make potato pancakes for her. Then I can say sorry.
items.quest_leo-15_say: Let's go and say sorry to Mia.
items.quest_leo-20: I have a big plan. Let's build a tree house! We can see the whole town from up there. You are my best friend, so you get the first key!
items.quest_nora-15: Oh no! I forgot to make rice bread for the school picnic! The kids will be here in one hour. Please bring four bags of rice. Let's make the bread now!
items.quest_nora-15_say: Don't worry. We can do it!
items.quest_nora-20: I want to give my bakery a new name. I'll call it Friends Bakery, because of you. Can you hang a lantern by the new sign?
items.quest_ben-15: Oh no, it's raining. The soccer game is canceled. I'm so bored! I don't like rainy days. Let's make rice balls and watch soccer on TV. Can you bring three bags of rice?
items.quest_ben-15_say: Rainy days can be fun, too!
items.quest_ben-20: My mom and I started a band! She sings, and I play the drums. Our first concert is at the bakery tonight. Can you help us carry the drums?
items.quest_ben-20_say: You are the best band in town!
items.quest_sam-15: Can I tell you a secret? I grew up in this town a long time ago. There was a big tree here. Let's plant a new one.
items.quest_sam-20: I want to draw a new map of our town. Let's walk around and look at every street. Here. This map is for you. Keep it forever.
items.quest_lily-15: Oh no, my flower cart is so messy! I can't find my scissors anywhere. Can you help me clean up?
items.quest_lily-20: I painted a picture of our town. Look! There are flowers everywhere. I'll hang it in Mia's library. Let's put some flowers around it.
items.quest_tom-15: Oh no! I lost a letter for Sam. Can you help me look for it? Look! It's under the bench!
items.quest_tom-20: Today I have a letter for you. It's from me! Thank you for being my friend. Let's make rice balls and read it together.
items.quest_tom-20_say: This is the best letter ever!
items.quest_jack-15: A storm is coming, but I want to go fishing. You think it's not safe? Hmm... OK, you're right. Let's stay in and make potato soup.
items.quest_jack-20: I have shells from many different places. Let's make a wooden box for them. Choose your favorite shell. It's a gift for you!
items.quest_jack-20_say: Thank you for this beautiful shell!
items.quest_rosa-15: Let's take a walk around town this morning. Walking every day keeps you healthy. Look! The sun is coming up.
items.quest_rosa-20: My clinic is too hot in the summer. Sick people need a cool place to rest. Let's plant a tree by the door. It will give us shade.
items.quest_rosa-20_say: Your clinic looks so nice now!
items.quest_max-15: I lost the swimming race today. I showed off too much, and I didn't practice enough. Will you practice with me every morning?
items.quest_max-20: I won the big swimming race! You helped me win. Thank you! Bring me some gold ore. I'll make a medal for you, too!
